exposure: Thiocolchicoside (TCC) at doses of 8 mcg, 16 mcg, 32 mcg
cohort: A total of 80 chicken embryos, incubated for 24 hours before treatment and evaluated on the 10th day of incubation.
finding: Thiocolchicoside (TCC) caused a high rate of early embryo death and midline closure defects in developing chicken embryos.
